summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its expected inclusion in the FTSE Russell 1000 and 3000 indexes, effective June 29, 2026. No merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described. The filing merely reports a routine index addition based on market-cap rankings. There is no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory condition involved. As a routine market-index announcement, this filing does not constitute a special situation under event-driven analysis.
